description: Tag-driven home-screen rows and the rule that fills each one.
The July 2026 re-tag pilot: per Harborlight title, impressions and play starts 4 weeks before vs 4 weeks from the pilot date. pilot_group = 'Pilot (re-tagged)' | 'Control (not re-tagged)'.

One row per title: current metadata vs the AI proposal (ai_* columns), completeness_score (0-100), last-4-week engagement (impressions_4w, play_starts_4w, completion_rate_4w), peer benchmark, discovery gap, missing_warnings, safety_risk, hidden_gem, retag_priority_score.
tier implied by the AI-detected content warnings
CURRENT live ad-inventory tier: Family-Safe | Standard | Restricted
completions / play starts over the last 4 complete weeks (0-1)
viewers finish it at or above the genre peer median but it gets < 40% of a well-tagged peer's impressions
Orbitline Original | Studio Licensed | Harborlight Library
Weekly engagement per title (26 weeks). library_group = 'Harborlight - re-tagged in pilot' | 'Harborlight - not re-tagged' | 'Rest of library'.

content:
Orbitline+ is a (fictional) streaming service. Its library has 1,400 titles from three sources: 'Orbitline Original', 'Studio Licensed' and 'Harborlight Library' (420 titles acquired on 2026-04-13 from a legacy vendor feed with almost no metadata).
Home rows, search and recommendations are TAG-DRIVEN, so a title's metadata completeness (completeness_score 0-100) drives its impressions. Impressions = times the title tile was shown. PLAY RATE = play_starts / impressions. COMPLETION RATE = completions / play_starts (a measure of content quality once found).
Default time window: the last 4 complete weeks. In gold_title_scorecard the *_4w columns already cover it; in gold_title_weekly use week_start > (SELECT date_sub(max(week_start), 28) FROM gold_title_weekly). Never use current_date() — the data ends at the last complete week.
Always compare Harborlight with the rest of the library on a PER-TITLE basis (impressions per title) or as share of impressions vs share of catalogue — the sources have different title counts.
The July re-tag pilot: 40 Harborlight titles were hand re-tagged by editors on 2026-07-27. For its impact use gold_retag_pilot and report impressions and play starts before vs after for BOTH pilot_group values with the multiplier (after / before).
HIDDEN GEM = hidden_gem = true. SAFETY RISK = a title currently sold as brand_safety_tier = 'Family-Safe' whose ai_brand_safety_tier is 'Standard' or 'Restricted' (AI found content warnings the live metadata lacks); missing_warnings lists them. Kids/family rows are 'Little Ones (under 7)' and 'Family Movie Night' in the collections array.
Round percentages to 1 decimal and present them as percentages. When listing titles, include title and source.
ROUTING: numbers, counts, amounts, rates, trends -> query the TABLES (SQL); never answer numbers from a document. Policy, procedure, guideline, contract and 'what does the document say' questions -> search the attached documents and cite the document name + section.

question: How many titles are sold as Family-Safe but have AI-detected content warnings, by source?
sql:
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS titles_at_risk, COUNT_IF(ai_brand_safety_tier = 'Restricted') AS should_be_restricted,
  COUNT_IF(array_contains(collections, 'Little Ones (under 7)') OR array_contains(collections, 'Family Movie Night')) AS in_kids_or_family_rows
FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_title_scorecard WHERE brand_safety_tier = 'Family-Safe' AND ai_brand_safety_tier <> 'Family-Safe'
GROUP BY source ORDER BY titles_at_risk DESC

question: What happened to impressions and play starts for the titles re-tagged in the July pilot vs the rest of Harborlight?
sql:
SELECT pilot_group, COUNT(*) AS titles, SUM(impressions_4w_before) AS impressions_4w_before, SUM(impressions_4w_after) AS impressions_4w_after,
  ROUND(SUM(impressions_4w_after) / SUM(impressions_4w_before), 1) AS impressions_multiplier,
  SUM(play_starts_4w_before) AS play_starts_4w_before, SUM(play_starts_4w_after) AS play_starts_4w_after,
  ROUND(SUM(play_starts_4w_after) / SUM(play_starts_4w_before), 1) AS play_starts_multiplier
FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_retag_pilot GROUP BY pilot_group

question: Which hidden gems have the biggest discovery gap?
sql:
SELECT title, source, primary_genre, completeness_score, impressions_4w, peer_impressions_4w, ROUND(100 * completion_rate_4w, 1) AS completion_pct,
  ROUND(100 * peer_completion_rate_4w, 1) AS peer_completion_pct, discovery_gap_impressions_4w
FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_title_scorecard WHERE hidden_gem ORDER BY discovery_gap_impressions_4w DESC LIMIT 10

question: What share of impressions does the Harborlight library get compared with its share of the catalogue?
sql:
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS titles, ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_catalogue,
  SUM(impressions_4w) AS impressions_4w, ROUND(100 * SUM(impressions_4w) / SUM(SUM(impressions_4w)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_impressions,
  ROUND(AVG(completeness_score), 1) AS avg_completeness
FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_title_scorecard GROUP BY source ORDER BY pct_of_impressions

question: Do Harborlight titles perform worse when viewers actually watch them?
sql:
SELECT library_group, COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS titles, ROUND(SUM(impressions) / COUNT(DISTINCT title_id)) AS impressions_per_title,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(play_starts) / SUM(impressions), 2) AS play_rate_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(completions) / SUM(play_starts), 1) AS completion_rate_pct
FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_title_weekly WHERE week_start > (SELECT date_sub(max(week_start), 28) FROM media_advertising.content_metadata_copilot.gold_title_weekly)
GROUP BY library_group ORDER BY impressions_per_title
